Servi Plus is a high-capacity restaurant robot waiter designed to transform modern hospitality workflows. With an expanded payload, Servi Plus can carry up to 16 entrees or 88 lbs while smoothly and safely navigating tight spaces. Learn how this autonomous mobile robot supports hospitality staff, scales with multi-robot orchestration, and improves workflows.

Servi Plus is a high-capacity restaurant robot waiter designed to transform modern hospitality workflows. With an expanded payload, Servi Plus can carry up to 16 entrees or 88 lbs while smoothly and safely navigating tight spaces. Learn how this autonomous mobile robot supports hospitality staff, scales with multi-robot orchestration, and improves workflows.

Custom configuration

From the smallest bites to the tallest orders, this service robot stacks up to any expectation.

Digital display

Personalize experiences or promote your brand through integrated LED display and sound system.

Ambient accent lighting

This robot waiter creates stunning reveals with responsive presentation lighting.

Ambient accent lighting

Pillar lighting

Tray highlight

Nimble navigation

Engineered to traverse the tightest spaces, this restaurant robot drives itself while detecting obstacles in all directions. If anything stands in its way, it reroutes in real time to keep service on schedule.

Powerful performance

High capacity

Servi Plus carries over 16 entrees up to 88 lbs at once, and up to 4 extra-large trays or 4 standard bus tubs.

Fluid motion

Designed with an active suspension for stable food and liquid delivery, Servi Plus glides across a variety of flooring types, ADA ramps, and thresholds up to 1/2".

Stable deliveries

Calibrated speed and parking presets assist with flawless soup and drink delivery.

See Servi Plus in action

Discover how Servi Plus helps your staff serve better.

See it in action

Multi-robot mode

Program a fleet of service robots that scales with your business. Our centralized control system allows multi-robot orchestration with no deadlocks or congestion.

Run your fleet from one dashboard

30 robots a major helping hand in Bangujeong restaurant.

AMR solutions at scale

We’ve engineered all our autonomous mobile robots to evolve with your business. With multi-robot orchestration, we’re ensuring quality service moves at the speed of your success.

Ideal for:

Faster service – More service robots mean speedier deliveries and quicker clean-up.

Better service – Organized automation allows servers to focus on customers.

Easy adaptation – Multiple AMR robots make it easy to adjust between busy and slow shifts.

FAQ

Are service robots simple to maintain?

Yes, our Servi Restaurant Robots are rated for safe and sanitary use around the front and back of house environments. Tray components are dishwasher safe. Also, our team is always available for software updates and fixes. In addition, we offer a variety of warranty terms to cover our comprehensive set of subscription and purchase types.

I’m not extremely tech savvy. Will I be able to operate this service robot?

Servi is designed to be very user-friendly. Our field operations team will be onsite for 2-3 days for installation and training to ensure Servi is ready to go. Also, we handle all the upfront installation, like mapping, workflow integration, and even provide tech support both on and off-site.

How do I know Servi Plus is right for my business?

We’ve made the ownership opportunity as seamless as the service robot itself. We offer trial periods and a subscription model so you can experience the difference first hand.
